key_points: Multiple analysts issue extreme bullish targets ($3,000 vs ~$1,070), likely speculative froth rather than thesis change
Taiwan labor strike risk emerges but market appears to be brushing off near-term supply disruption fears
Samsung's record $80B Q3 profit signals strong memory demand cycle, benefiting Micron but also highlighting competitive intensity
Seeking Alpha and TheStreet highlight structural 3-5 year bull case, suggesting some fundamental reassessment underway
Overall headline mix reflects momentum-driven optimism with genuine cyclical tailwinds; long-term investors should weigh valuation vs. cycle sustainability
